steps.what: Verify specimen, study purpose and required chromosome-pair identification detail
Find exact indexed validated protocols matching specified specimen and method categories
Read the actual banding protocols, limitations and quality requirements
Select the banding method that permits identification of the required chromosome pairs
Enter the selected method in the existing laboratory work instruction

tasks.design: Test native protocol-index filtering in {DOCS} for exact specimen and method categories. It replaces manual reference matching only; the technologist reads limitations, chooses the banding method and retains the actual case work instruction in {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated reference matching accompanies a consequential method-selection decision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed fields can expose validated protocol references without recommending a clinical method.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a method that reveals the required chromosome detail in the actual specimen.
tasks.human_edge: Judge specimen suitability and limitations of available banding approaches.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated protocol-reference matching with unchanged method choice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed protocol libraries can filter exact specimen and method fields, but chromosome banding selection requires technologist judgement.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for existing manual protocol-reference matching. OTHER is the laboratory information application. The work instruction already directs specimen processing; it is not a new selection log.

The laboratory protocol owner supplies protocol ID/version, specimen category, method category and current status; the technologist verifies case and categories in s1. Missing indexing and unfamiliar specimens return to manual search within retained work, not a free new tagged library.

Native filtering comes first. Only 15 manual reference-matching points are removed, not source reading, method selection or existing search runtime. s1/s3 retain missing-source repair; more repair lowers benefits.

The lookup is not an eligibility or suitability verdict. Original instruction entry and ordinary author saves in s5 stay fully retained and ungated; no procedure activation or result release is assumed.
unknowns: Actual validated protocol index and repeated matching effort
research_questions: Find banding references for a real case and measure missing indexing separately from method judgement.

incremental.description: Maintain protocol-index mappings and retired-version checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 reference-matching points less 1 upkeep. A rare specimen needs manual method research; reuse only 3 points of exact standard protocol references: 3 minus 1 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and monitor cytogenetic quality programs

steps.what: Define cytogenetic quality objectives, acceptance rules and the proposed program revision
Collect and verify actual control, test-performance and report-quality observations
Repeat specified quality statistics, trend charts and explicit threshold comparisons
Interpret quality findings and decide corrective or program changes
Write and check the actual quality-program revision and monitoring report
outputs: checked final quality revision and report

loop.purpose: Restate specified quality conclusions and program changes
loop.input: Technologist-authored conclusions, exact changes and verified result references
loop.output: Draft revised quality protocol and monitoring narrative
loop.check: Technologist checks procedural meaning, omitted controls, report limitations and each acceptance or corrective-action statement against their conclusions
loop.stop: Unsupported acceptance, altered control requirement or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native quality tables and protocol fields come first; variable monitoring rationale needs bounded restatement

steps.what: Review the exact final quality revision, report and implementation scope
inputs: checked final quality revision and report

steps.what: Activate the approved quality-program revision for the specified tests and laboratory

tasks.design: Configure native quality trends and explicit threshold checks in the laboratory quality application in {OTHER}. A bounded draft in {DOCS} restates technologist-chosen changes and findings, retaining quality decisions and final lead review before the separate program activation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated statistics and monitoring prose accompany quality-program judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native charts and fixed rules can repeat selected comparisons without accepting tests or choosing corrective action.
tasks.still_hard: Determining whether controls and report quality establish reliable cytogenetic performance.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise meaningful quality failures and choose appropriate investigation and changes.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated quality calculation and restatement with unchanged laboratory authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory quality applications can chart specified control data and flag explicit limits, but quality acceptance and corrective action require professional judgement.

assumptions: Provisional cycle includes an actual quality-program revision and report used by laboratory staff. Focal technologist baseline is 96 points; 4 lead-review points remain other-role work excluded from savings. Monitoring without revision needs reweighting without inventing activation.

The technologist verifies test/probe ID, run, control result, unit, method revision, quality finding and selected acceptance rules in s1-s2. Collection, extraction and missing-data repair remain counted; no free validated quality feed is assumed. OTHER is the laboratory quality application.

Native charts and fields come first. Only 25 repeated manual statistics/chart points and 3 of 15 narrative-restatement points are removed. s4-s5 retain full interpretation, independent checks, substantive writing, repair and ordinary saves; excess repair lowers benefits.

s6 follows the final revised protocol and report and binds exact revision and implementation scope. Changes void approval. s7 is real quality-program activation, fully retained; ordinary draft saves remain ungated. No automatic test release or clinical result send is assumed.
unknowns: Existing quality automation and actual revision cycle
research_questions: Replay one quality review and count input repair, chart interactions, narrative corrections and activation.

incremental.description: Maintain validated quality-rule examples and monitoring-draft checks

approvals.approved_version: s6 exact final quality revision, report and test/laboratory scope; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 28 of 96 technologist points = 29.17%, less 2 upkeep = 27.17%. New probes have incompatible control series; reuse only 5 points of established statistics and 0.5 factual report wording: 5.5/96*100 minus 2 = 3.73%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review actual culture condition, cell-growth evidence and harvest requirements
Develop candidate manual or robotic harvest sequences for the actual cultures
Compare specified sequence times against exact validated incubation and equipment windows
Check comparisons and determine the optimal harvest time sequence and method
outputs: technologist's selected harvest method and timing

tasks.design: Test native timing tables in the laboratory scheduling application in {OTHER}. Compare exact validated windows for the technologist's candidate sequences, retaining culture assessment, candidate design and the final choice of harvest method and timing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated time-window arithmetic accompanies biological judgement about harvest readiness.
tasks.enabler_now: Native time calculations can compare explicit sequences without deciding biological readiness.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing timing that yields usable chromosomes from the actual culture.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret growth evidence and recognise when standard timing is unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated timing arithmetic with unchanged harvest choice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: timing tools can compare explicit incubation and equipment windows, but cell-harvest readiness and method selection require technologist judgement.

assumptions: Provisional boundary determines timing and method, before harvesting or loading a robot. OTHER is the laboratory scheduling application. No robot command, activation or new harvest log is assumed.

The technologist verifies culture ID, current condition, protocol revision, candidate durations and validated windows in s1-s2. Actual observation and source extraction remain counted. Missing windows or incompatible culture conditions require manual assessment within retained work.

Native timing tables come first. Only 15 repeated manual arithmetic/comparison points are removed, not existing scheduling runtime. s4 retains independent checks, unsupported-case repair and actual decision documentation/ordinary save; excess repair lowers savings.
No rule declares the biologically optimal harvest. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained and ungated; actual robot deployment would require a separate counted gated action.
unknowns: Existing timing automation and validated-window compatibility
research_questions: Replay one harvest-planning decision and count repeated time arithmetic separately from biological judgement.

incremental.description: Maintain validated timing-rule mappings and regression examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 timing-comparison points less 1.5 upkeep. An unfamiliar culture needs bespoke biological timing; reuse only 3 points of compatible equipment-window arithmetic: 3 minus 1.5 = 1.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Archive cytogenetic case documentation and study materials

steps.what: Verify case documentation, study materials, retention requirements and source completeness
Assemble the selected case files, images and source metadata into an archive package
Check final archive contents, exact metadata and the separate archive destination
outputs: approved archive package, metadata and destination

steps.what: Re-key approved case metadata and transfer its package into the separate archive repository
inputs: approved archive package, metadata and destination

steps.what: Check archive receipt and resolve missing-file or metadata rejections

tasks.design: Test native case-package export from the laboratory application and import into the separate archive repository, both in {OTHER}. Retain source and retention checks, verify the final package and destination, then replace duplicate metadata entry into that second repository and check its receipt.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case materials are manually assembled and their identifiers entered again in a distinct archive system.
tasks.enabler_now: Native package export and fixed metadata mappings can remove those repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring the case archive is complete, readable and subject to the correct retention requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise missing study evidence and decide the appropriate archival scope.
tasks.altitude: Less package assembly and second-system re-keying with unchanged archive accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory applications can export selected case packages and archive repositories can import fixed metadata; completeness and retention requirements still need review.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is an existing two-system case archive, not an ordinary same-system save. OTHER comprises the source laboratory application and a distinct archival repository. A same-system archive has no second-entry benefit and needs reweighting without inventing it.

The technologist verifies case/specimen ID, source revision, study date, file list, formats, retention class and destination in s1. Existing study producers create the underlying materials, while source extraction and missing-file repair remain counted. No new free digitisation is assumed.

Native export/import comes first. Remove only 20 repeated manual package-assembly points and 30 actual duplicate metadata-entry/transfer points. s1/s3/s5 retain format repair, completeness checks and receipt exceptions; higher repair volume requires lower savings or more retained work.

s3 binds the exact final package, metadata and second-system destination before s4. Changes void approval. This gate covers the real second-repository transfer, never an ordinary author save; ordinary source saves remain fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Actual separate archive and manual duplicate-entry share
research_questions: Archive a real case through native export/import and count format repair, completeness checking and receipts.

incremental.description: Maintain archive metadata mappings and investigate new import failures

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final package, metadata and separate archive destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 20 package and 30 second-entry points less 1.5 upkeep. Legacy image formats and archive metadata leave only 4 compatible assembly points and 6 duplicate-entry points removable: 10 minus 1.5 = 8.5; format repair remains manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain cytogenetic decisions and quality authority while reducing verified protocol matching, quality calculations, timing comparisons and real second-system archive entry.
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous chromosome interpretation or clinical release is proposed.
